req.title: Update task
req.statement: The system shall update mutable fields of the task and return the updated object when PUT /tasks/{task_id} is called with a valid body.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the update functionality of the task management API. It includes a positive test to ensure correct updates, a negative test to handle invalid task IDs, and a boundary test to check behavior at the edge of valid input ranges.

tests.name: test_update_task_positive
preconditions: A task with ID 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to /tasks/1 with a valid update payload.
expected: The response contains the updated task object with the new title.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Precondition: Create a task to update
create_response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Initial Task", "description": "Initial Description", "completed": False})
assert create_response.status_code == 201
created_task = create_response.json()
task_id = created_task['id']

# Action: Update the task
update_response = client.put(f"/tasks/{task_id}", json={"title": "Updated Task"})

# Expected: Check the response
assert update_response.status_code == 200
updated_task = update_response.json()
assert updated_task['title'] == "Updated Task"
assert updated_task['id'] == task_id

tests.name: test_update_task_invalid_id
actions: Send a PUT request to /tasks/9999 with a valid update payload.
expected: Error message indicating task not found.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Action: Attempt to update a non-existent task
update_response = client.put("/tasks/9999", json={"title": "Non-existent Task"})

# Expected: Check the response
assert update_response.status_code == 404
assert update_response.json()['detail'] == "Task with id 9999 not found"

tests.name: test_update_task_boundary
preconditions: A task with ID 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to /tasks/1 with a title of maximum length (100 characters).
expected: The response contains the updated task object with the new title.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Precondition: Create a task to update
create_response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Initial Task", "description": "Initial Description", "completed": False})
assert create_response.status_code == 201
created_task = create_response.json()
task_id = created_task['id']

# Action: Update the task with a boundary title length
max_length_title = "T" * 100
update_response = client.put(f"/tasks/{task_id}", json={"title": max_length_title})

# Expected: Check the response
assert update_response.status_code == 200
updated_task = update_response.json()
assert updated_task['title'] == max_length_title
assert updated_task['id'] == task_id
